def factor_range_stability(df):
    # range ratio stability
    df_copy = df.copy()
    range_ratio = (df_copy['high'] - df_copy['low']) / df_copy['close'].replace(0.0, np.nan)
    stability = -range_ratio.rolling(20, min_periods=20).std(ddof=1)
    df_copy['factor_range_stability'] = stability
    return df_copy['factor_range_stability']
description: Measures the temporal consistency and smoothness of the daily price range relative to close. Stocks with a persistently narrow and stable trading range exhibit low rolling volatility of the range ratio, capturing a calm, persistent price-discovery process that is not captured by simple return volatility. The negative sign makes higher values indicate more stable range behavior.
